question:

Den mindste stigning så man på 2-værelsers boliger (11,7 %) og den højeste stigning så man på 3-værelsers boliger (14,3 %). However, in the latest statistics from the Scottish government, we have seen that only within the last year has the average rental have increased for all types of housing, regardless of size. The smallest increase was seen in 2-bedroom flats (11.7%) and the highest increase was seen in 3-bedroom flats (14.3%). Every type of property (from one to four bedroom to a room in a property) has had a double digit increase in rents since the Cost of Living legislation was introduced in October 2022, exceeding the annual average increases in rents over the previous 12 years by a factor of at least three.
